items.keyData: CARES-310 · mOS 23.8 vs 15.2 mo · HR 0.64 · mPFS 5.6 vs 3.7 mo
items.summary: Elevar and Hengrui refiled the NDA and BLA on 9 October after manufacturing-site inspections concluded; the July 2026 complete response letter (the third) cited manufacturing deficiencies, not efficacy or safety. The filing rests on the CARES-310 phase 3 trial versus sorafenib; no new PDUFA date has been announced.
items.title: Rivoceranib plus camrelizumab resubmitted to FDA for first-line unresectable HCC

items.keyData: AHEAD-MERIT (Ph 2/3) · PFS not significant · OS readout pending
items.summary: In first-line PD-L1 CPS ≥1, HPV16-positive recurrent/metastatic HNSCC, adding BNT113 to pembrolizumab did not significantly improve progression-free survival at this analysis. The IDMC recommended continuing the trial to the second dual primary endpoint, overall survival; no efficacy numbers were released.
items.title: AHEAD-MERIT: mRNA vaccine BNT113 plus pembrolizumab misses PFS endpoint in HPV16+ head and neck cancer

items.keyData: LBA1 INTerpath-001 · LBA11 TroFuse-005 · LBA12 KEYNOTE-C93 · 1239O NRG-GY020
items.summary: Merck listed three Presidential Symposium phase 3 presentations for ESMO (Madrid, 23–27 Oct): adjuvant mRNA neoantigen therapy intismeran plus pembrolizumab in melanoma (LBA1), sacituzumab tirumotecan in endometrial cancer (LBA11) and first-line pembrolizumab monotherapy in dMMR endometrial cancer (LBA12). NRG-GY020, testing pembrolizumab added to radiotherapy in endometrial cancer, is also being presented (1239O).
items.title: ESMO 2026 Presidential late-breakers: INTerpath-001, TroFuse-005 and KEYNOTE-C93; NRG-GY020 RT ± pembrolizumab also on programme

items.keyData: QoL improved 75.8% vs 6.3% · no exercise-related AEs · ~83% adherence ≥6 wk
items.summary: In a Brazilian randomised phase 2 trial (70 patients), a 12-week telehealth exercise programme led by a physiologist improved quality of life and cancer-related fatigue versus usual care, with roughly half the QoL gain explained by less fatigue. To be presented at the 2026 ASCO Quality Care Symposium.
items.title: Remote supervised exercise reduces fatigue and improves quality of life during immunotherapy

items.keyData: RELIGHT · OS CPS≥5 16.8 vs 10.4 mo, HR 0.53 · OS ITT 15.8 vs 11.2 mo, HR 0.66 · ORR 53.4% vs 32.8%
items.summary: This Chinese phase 3 trial (n=731) found that adding retlirafusp alfa to CAPOX prolonged overall survival in both the PD-L1 CPS ≥5 and intention-to-treat populations versus placebo plus CAPOX, published in JCO. The main limitation is the chemotherapy-alone comparator rather than PD-1 inhibitor plus chemotherapy.
items.title: RELIGHT: PD-L1/TGF-β trap retlirafusp alfa plus CAPOX improves survival in first-line HER2− gastric/GEJ cancer

items.keyData: Ph 1 (n=5) · 1 PR (~80% shrinkage) · no grade ≥3 AEs
items.summary: T-MAXIMUM's allogeneic B7-H3-directed CAR T product MT027 can proceed to a phase 2 study in brain metastases from lung or breast cancer. Supporting phase 1 data are very small: among 5 pretreated patients with lung cancer brain metastases there was 1 partial response and no grade ≥3 drug-related toxicity.
items.title: FDA clears phase 2 trial of intrathecal B7-H3 CAR T-cell therapy MT027 for brain metastases

items.keyData: C-800-01 (n=123, no liver mets) · ORR 21% · mOS 21.2 mo (exploratory)
items.summary: Armenia's health ministry authorised the Fc-enhanced CTLA-4 antibody botensilimab with PD-1 antibody balstilimab for previously treated MSS mCRC without active liver metastases, on a one-year renewable basis. Evidence is from single-arm studies; the OS-powered phase 3 BATTMAN trial was terminated after funding was withdrawn.
items.title: Armenia grants world-first conditional authorisation to botensilimab plus balstilimab in MSS colorectal cancer

items.keyData: RACC · intraop complications 5.7% vs 10.0% · RR 0.57 · stay 3 vs 5 days · RFS pending
items.summary: A prespecified secondary analysis of the 900-patient RACC randomised trial (stage IB1–IIA1) found fewer intraoperative complications, less blood loss and shorter stays with robot-assisted surgery, with similar 30-day postoperative complications. The oncological primary endpoint, recurrence-free survival, is still in follow-up — the key question after LACC.
items.title: RACC: robot-assisted radical hysterectomy has fewer intraoperative complications than open surgery in early cervical cancer

items.keyData: ACTION-1 (NCT05477576) · PFS primary endpoint met (no HR disclosed) · comparator: high-dose SSA, everolimus or sunitinib
items.summary: At a planned interim analysis, the phase 3 ACTION-1 trial met its primary endpoint of BICR-assessed PFS for RYZ101 versus investigator's-choice standard of care in SSTR-positive GEP-NETs progressing after Lu-177-based PRRT. Numbers were not released; full data will go to a future meeting and the company plans to discuss a filing with the FDA.
items.title: ACTION-1: alpha-emitter RYZ101 (225Ac-DOTATATE) improves PFS in GEP-NETs after Lu-177 therapy

items.keyData: Phase 2 NCT07111546 · ~140 enrolled · 2nd fast track (first: extrapulmonary NEC)
items.summary: The FDA granted fast track designation to opamtistomig (LBL-024) for first-line advanced or metastatic biliary tract cancer. A phase 2 study is testing it with gemcitabine-cisplatin or with bevacizumab, with BTC data expected at ESMO 2026.
items.title: Fast track for PD-L1/4-1BB bispecific opamtistomig in first-line biliary tract cancer

items.summary: An interim analysis of the phase 2 ENV-105 trial in mCRPC progressing on an AR pathway inhibitor showed markedly longer PFS when carotuximab was added to apalutamide versus apalutamide alone. Data are early and from a small open-label study.
items.title: Endoglin antibody carotuximab plus apalutamide prolongs PFS in mCRPC (phase 2 interim)

items.keyData: Localised Ewing: interval-compressed VDC/IE ×14 cycles · 5-yr survival 81% localised vs 41% metastatic
items.summary: NCCN released its first guideline for paediatric bone sarcoma covering Ewing sarcoma and other undifferentiated round cell sarcomas. Interval-compressed VDC alternating with IE is the recommended first-line systemic therapy for localised and metastatic Ewing sarcoma, with trial enrolment encouraged.
items.title: NCCN publishes first paediatric bone sarcoma guideline, focused on Ewing sarcoma

items.summary: The phase 3 NRG-GI003 trial (115 eligible patients) stopped for futility at interim analysis: protons did not extend overall or progression-free survival versus photons in advanced hepatocellular carcinoma. Grade ≥3 toxicity was numerically lower with protons but not statistically significant.
items.title: NRG-GI003: proton therapy does not improve survival over photon RT in advanced HCC

items.keyData: NRG-CC009 (n=151) · mOS 17.4 vs 8.6 mo · adj. HR death 0.60 (P=.016) · NCF HR 0.83 (P=.39)
items.summary: In 151 patients with SCLC brain metastases randomised to stereotactic radiosurgery or hippocampal-avoidant whole-brain RT plus memantine, the primary endpoint of time to neurocognitive failure did not differ, but overall survival was longer with SRS. Presented at the ASTRO 2026 plenary, it supports SRS as a reasonable option in SCLC.
items.title: NRG-CC009: SRS instead of HA-WBRT for SCLC brain metastases — no cognitive difference, longer survival

items.keyData: TRIlogy-1 · n=56 · MRD-neg 95% (10⁻⁵), 93.3% (10⁻⁶) among tested · median 3 prior lines
items.summary: Phase 1 TRIlogy-1 data presented at IMS 2026 showed very high rates of MRD negativity with ramantamig (JNJ-5322) monotherapy in heavily pretreated, largely anti-CD38-refractory relapsed/refractory myeloma.
items.title: Trispecific ramantamig achieves high MRD negativity in triple-class-exposed myeloma

items.keyData: ROAM/EORTC-1308 · n=157 · 5-y DFS 79.9% vs 64.3% · HR 0.51 · recurrence 14% vs 30% · median FU 64 mo
items.summary: In the first randomised trial of its kind, 60 Gy IMRT after complete resection of WHO grade 2 meningioma halved the risk of recurrence or death versus active MRI surveillance, with more adverse events but no clear cognitive or QoL penalty; no overall survival difference so far. Published in The Lancet.
items.title: ROAM/EORTC-1308: adjuvant radiotherapy cuts recurrence after gross total resection of atypical meningioma

items.keyData: Belgium, Denmark, France, Ireland, Italy, Netherlands, Sweden, Switzerland · IV Keytruda unaffected
items.summary: A court in the Netherlands found that Merck's subcutaneous Keytruda infringes a Halozyme hyaluronidase (MDASE) patent and ordered Merck to stop making and selling it in eight countries; intravenous pembrolizumab is unaffected, and a separate German injunction is under appeal.
items.title: Dutch court blocks subcutaneous pembrolizumab in eight European countries over Halozyme patent

items.keyData: OST31-164-01 · n=41 · 3-y OS 72.7% vs 45.8% historical · 12-mo EFS 33% vs 20%
items.summary: Final phase 2b data for daznelimgene lisbac showed higher 3-year overall survival than a pooled historical control in adolescents and young adults after complete resection of pulmonary metastases; the comparison is non-randomised. An accelerated-approval BLA is planned for Q4 2026.
items.title: Listeria-based HER2 immunotherapy OST-HER2 reports 3-year OS in resected lung-metastatic osteosarcoma

items.keyData: PrTK03 parent trial · DFS HR 0.70 · negative biopsy at 22-26 mo 80% vs 63% · paired residual-tumour analysis n=108
items.summary: An ASTRO 2026 late-breaker used machine-learning digital pathology on biopsies from the phase 3 PrTK03 trial and found greater immune infiltration after intraprostatic aglatimagene plus EBRT than after placebo plus EBRT, offering a possible mechanism for the trial's DFS benefit; P values are nominal.
items.title: Aglatimagene with EBRT increases intratumoral lymphocytes in localized prostate cancer (PrTK03 translational analysis)

items.keyData: n=3,259 · 6-mo abstinence 8.8% (incentives) vs 5.1% (pharmacotherapy) vs 4.3% (usual care) · +4.6 pts vs usual care, P<.001
items.summary: A four-arm pragmatic RCT in JAMA found that adding cash incentives for biochemically confirmed abstinence raised 6-month quit rates over usual care and over free pharmacotherapy alone, while a mobile health tool added nothing further.
items.title: Financial incentives double quit rates in underserved patients referred for lung cancer screening

items.summary: The cfDNA screening test, which also predicts the cancer signal origin, received Breakthrough Device status after FDA review of data across 12 cancer types; no performance figures were disclosed and the designation is not a clearance.
items.title: Natera's blood-based multi-cancer early detection assay gets FDA Breakthrough Device designation

items.keyData: 25,328 exams (4,218 ABUS vs 21,110 HHUS) · CDR similar · recall lower with ABUS
items.source: Journal of the American College of Radiology
items.summary: Across 25,328 screening ultrasound exams in three US BCSC registries, automated breast ultrasound had a similar cancer detection rate to handheld ultrasound with lower recall and false-positive rates.
items.title: Automated breast ultrasound matches handheld ultrasound for supplemental screening with fewer recalls

items.keyData: TROPION-Breast02 · mPFS 10.8 vs 5.6 mo · HR 0.57 · mOS 23.7 vs 18.7 mo · HR 0.79 · ORR 63% vs 29%
items.summary: China's NMPA approved Dato-DXd for unresectable or metastatic triple-negative breast cancer in patients who are not candidates for PD-1/PD-L1 inhibitors, based on TROPION-Breast02, which showed PFS and OS gains over chemotherapy.
items.title: China approves datopotamab deruxtecan for metastatic TNBC unsuitable for PD-(L)1 therapy

items.summary: The liquid biopsy received IVDR CE marking to detect ESR1 mutations that select patients for camizestrant plus a CDK4/6 inhibitor in ER+/HER2− advanced breast cancer, following the EU approval of camizestrant in July 2026.
items.title: Guardant360 CDx certified in EU as companion diagnostic for camizestrant

items.keyData: Phase 1, n=33 · relapses 0/16 vs 3/16 (median 30 mo) · immune response 73% · no grade ≥3 vaccine AEs
items.summary: In a small randomised phase 1 study after surgery and adjuvant therapy, immediate TG4050 vaccination produced neoantigen-specific immune responses with no relapses versus 3 relapses in the observation arm; the trial was not powered for efficacy.
items.title: Individualised neoantigen vaccine TG4050 shows durable T-cell responses in resected HPV-negative HNSCC

items.keyData: 110 drugs (35 patented) · margin cap 30% of MRP
items.summary: According to government sources, trade margins on 110 non-scheduled anti-cancer medicines, including 35 patented drugs, will be limited to 30% of MRP, covering branded, generic and imported products; implementation is expected later in October.
items.title: India to cap trade margins on 110 anti-cancer drugs at 30% of MRP

items.keyData: DESTINY-Breast05 · IDFS HR 0.47 · 3-yr IDFS 92.4% vs 83.7% (vs T-DM1)
items.summary: NMPA approved trastuzumab deruxtecan as adjuvant therapy after neoadjuvant taxane-trastuzumab when invasive disease remains, based on DESTINY-Breast05 versus T-DM1.
items.title: China approves adjuvant T-DXd for HER2+ early breast cancer with residual disease

items.keyData: FURVENT · 240 mg mPFS 11.0 vs 9.5 mo · HR 0.75 (p=0.065) · ORR 60% vs 33%
items.summary: Neither firmonertinib dose significantly improved BICR-assessed PFS over platinum-pemetrexed, although the 240 mg arm had a higher response rate and fewer grade ≥3 treatment-related AEs; the sponsor is reviewing next steps.
items.title: FURVENT: firmonertinib misses PFS endpoint in first-line EGFR exon 20 insertion NSCLC

items.keyData: EPCORE DLBCL-2 · PFS HR 0.49 (IPI 3–5 and IPI 2–5) · p<0.0001
items.summary: Topline phase 3 results show adding the CD20xCD3 bispecific to R-CHOP roughly halved the risk of progression or death in IPI 3–5 and IPI 2–5 patients; OS and safety details are awaited.
items.title: EPCORE DLBCL-2: epcoritamab plus R-CHOP improves PFS in newly diagnosed high-risk DLBCL

items.keyData: n=242 · 1-yr cavity control 87% vs 81% (p=0.046) · mOS 29 vs 20 mo · HR 0.69 (p=0.035) · necrosis 14% vs 10%
items.summary: In a phase 3 trial of 242 patients with a resected brain metastasis over 2 cm, 3–5 fraction SRS improved surgical-bed control and overall survival versus single-fraction SRS without more toxicity; the investigators propose fSRS as standard of care for larger cavities.
items.title: Alliance A071801: fractionated SRS beats single-fraction SRS after resection of brain metastases

items.keyData: Neoadjuvant THP · HER2DX + ER status → pCR prediction
items.summary: ER status and the HER2DX genomic score predicted complete response to de-escalated neoadjuvant paclitaxel-trastuzumab-pertuzumab in HER2-positive early breast cancer.
items.title: HER2DX score and hormone receptor status predict pCR with neoadjuvant THP

items.keyData: EXCALIBER-RRMM phase 3 · IberDd vs DVd · PFS risk ↓51%
items.summary: Iberdomide plus daratumumab and dexamethasone improved progression-free survival versus daratumumab, bortezomib and dexamethasone in the phase 3 trial.
items.title: EXCALIBER-RRMM: iberdomide-dara-dex beats DVd in relapsed myeloma

items.summary: Vir Biotechnology's masked, PSMA-directed T-cell engager VIR-5500 received FDA fast track designation for metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer.
items.title: Fast track for PSMA-targeted T-cell engager VIR-5500 in mCRPC

items.summary: A pan-cancer analysis found that restricting germline testing by age at diagnosis overlooks most pathogenic inherited variants, supporting broader testing for treatment and family-risk decisions.
items.title: Age-based germline testing criteria miss most inherited cancer variants

items.keyData: ATOMIC (phase 3) · adjuvant atezolizumab + mFOLFOX6 vs mFOLFOX6
items.summary: Atezolizumab added to adjuvant FOLFOX for resected stage III deficient mismatch repair colon cancer, based on the phase 3 ATOMIC trial.
items.title: FDA approves adjuvant atezolizumab plus chemotherapy for dMMR colon cancer

items.keyData: HER2CLIMB-05 · mPFS 24.9 vs 16.3 mo
items.summary: Tucatinib added to maintenance trastuzumab and pertuzumab after first-line induction, based on the HER2CLIMB-05 trial.
items.title: FDA approves tucatinib maintenance with trastuzumab–pertuzumab in HER2+ metastatic breast cancer

items.keyData: SURVIVE · OS primary endpoint not met · benefit in ≤65 y subgroup
items.summary: The survivin-targeted vaccine did not meet its primary overall survival endpoint because the standard-of-care arm lived longer than expected; benefit was seen in patients aged 65 or younger.
items.title: SURVIVE: SurVaxM misses OS endpoint in newly diagnosed glioblastoma

items.summary: The FDA granted breakthrough therapy designation to Temab-A in colorectal cancer and in c-Met–expressing non-small cell lung cancer.
items.title: c-Met ADC telisotuzumab adizutecan (Temab-A) gets two breakthrough designations

items.keyData: NRG-BR002 (n=125) · mPFS 23 mo SOC vs 19.5 mo with ablation · OS no difference
items.summary: Adding SBRT or surgery to all metastatic sites on top of first-line systemic therapy did not improve progression-free or overall survival in oligometastatic breast cancer (≤4 metastases), so the phase 3 part will not proceed. Full results published in JCO.
items.title: NRG-BR002: SBRT to oligometastases fails to extend PFS in breast cancer

items.keyData: BRUIN CLL-313 (n=282) · PFS HR 0.20 vs BR · mPFS NE vs 33.5 mo
items.summary: The non-covalent BTK inhibitor is now approved first line for chronic lymphocytic leukaemia or small lymphocytic lymphoma without known 17p deletion, after beating bendamustine-rituximab.
items.title: FDA approves pirtobrutinib for previously untreated CLL/SLL

items.keyData: ALKOVE-1 · ORR 31% · intracranial 32% · G1202R ORR 68%
items.summary: Next-generation ALK TKI under priority review, with activity against G1202R.
items.title: Neladalkib in pretreated ALK+ NSCLC

items.keyData: TALAPRO-3 · rPFS HR 0.48 · 3-y rPFS 77% vs 56%
items.summary: Priority review for the PARP inhibitor combination in castration-sensitive disease.
items.title: Talazoparib + enzalutamide in HRR-mutated mCSPC

items.keyData: iMMagine-1 · ORR 97% · sCR/CR 68%
items.summary: BCMA-directed CAR T-cell therapy.
items.title: Anito-cel in relapsed/refractory myeloma after ≥3 lines

items.keyData: MANEUVER · ORR 54.0% vs 3.2% at wk 25
items.summary: Oral CSF-1R inhibitor with breakthrough designation; also improved pain, stiffness and function.
items.title: Pimicotinib in tenosynovial giant cell tumour

items.keyData: PEAK · mPFS 16.5 vs 9.2 mo · HR 0.50
items.summary: Type 1 plus type 2 KIT inhibition to cover more resistance mutations.
items.title: Bezuclastinib + sunitinib in GIST after imatinib

items.keyData: lidERA · IDFS HR 0.70 vs standard endocrine therapy
items.summary: Would be the first oral SERD in the curative setting.
items.title: Giredestrant as adjuvant therapy in ER+/HER2− early breast cancer

items.keyData: PROSPECT (n=48) · ORR 66.7% · CR/CRu 43.8% · mPFS 6.0 mo
items.summary: Second-generation BTK inhibitor, already approved in Japan.
items.title: Tirabrutinib in relapsed/refractory primary CNS lymphoma

items.keyData: evERA · mPFS 8.77 vs 5.49 mo · HR 0.56 (ESR1m HR 0.38)
items.summary: After progression on prior endocrine-based therapy.
items.title: Giredestrant + everolimus in ESR1-mutated advanced breast cancer

items.keyData: HARMONi · mPFS 6.8 vs 4.4 mo · HR 0.52
items.summary: PD-1/VEGF bispecific antibody with platinum doublet after osimertinib-type progression.
items.title: Ivonescimab + chemo in EGFR-mutant NSCLC after 3rd-gen TKI

items.keyData: ESMO 2026 · Madrid · Oct 23–27
items.summary: Expected highlights include postMONARCH and FINER overall survival in HR+ breast cancer, TALAPRO-3 in mCSPC, SARON consolidation radiotherapy in oligometastatic NSCLC, LITESPARK-011 final results and HERIZON-GEA-01 in gastroesophageal cancer.
items.title: ESMO Congress 2026, Madrid, 23–27 October: readouts to watch

items.keyData: IDeate-Lung01 · ORR 48.2% · mDOR 5.3 mo · ILD 12.4%
items.summary: Daiichi Sankyo and Merck withdrew the ifinatamab deruxtecan BLA after the FDA said phase 2 IDeate-Lung01 data did not meet accelerated approval requirements. Phase 3 IDeate-Lung02 is nearly fully enrolled.
items.title: I-DXd application in extensive-stage SCLC withdrawn

items.keyData: VOLGA (n=695) · EFS and OS improved vs radical cystectomy
items.summary: Priority review granted based on VOLGA, which improved event-free and overall survival versus cystectomy alone. Decision expected in the fourth quarter of 2026.
items.title: Perioperative durvalumab + enfortumab vedotin in cisplatin-ineligible MIBC

items.keyData: OASIS-4 (n=474) · −3.4 episodes/day vs placebo at wk 12
items.summary: The dual NK-1/NK-3 antagonist is under priority review for moderate to severe hot flushes in patients on endocrine therapy for HR+ breast cancer.
items.title: Elinzanetant gets priority review for vasomotor symptoms on endocrine therapy

items.keyData: LITESPARK-011 · mPFS 14.6 vs 10.6 mo · HR 0.74 · ORR 53% vs 40% · OS HR 0.85 (NS)
items.summary: The HIF-2α inhibitor combination beat cabozantinib on PFS and response; final overall survival was not statistically significant.
items.title: FDA approves belzutifan plus lenvatinib for ccRCC after PD-1/PD-L1 therapy

items.keyData: Benefit-risk 7–2 · PATHFINDER 2 sensitivity 35.0%, specificity 99.85%
items.summary: Advisory panel supported the blood test as a prescription screen for adults 50 and older. The vote does not bind the FDA's final decision.
items.title: FDA panel votes in favour of Galleri multi-cancer early detection test

items.summary: Fast track in osteosarcoma and orphan drug designation in soft tissue sarcoma; first-in-human trial expected later in 2026.
items.title: LRRC15-directed ADC SOT106 gets new designations in sarcoma

items.keyData: REFOCUS (n=114) · ORR 46% · mDOR 11.8 · mPFS 11.3 · mOS 22.8 mo
items.summary: An irreversible, selective FGFR2 inhibitor for previously treated advanced cholangiocarcinoma with FGFR2 fusions or rearrangements. Nail toxicity, hand-foot syndrome and stomatitis were common.
items.title: FDA approves lirafugratinib for FGFR2-fusion cholangiocarcinoma

items.summary: Lantheus's Bravnetsa (formerly PNT2003) received final FDA approval after a March 2026 tentative approval, as a product the FDA judged bioequivalent and therapeutically equivalent to Lutathera.
items.title: Bravnetsa (Lu-177 dotatate) gets final approval for GEP-NETs

items.keyData: COMPANION-002 · ORR 18.0% vs 5.3% · PFS HR 0.44 · OS 8.9 vs 9.4 mo (HR 1.05)
items.summary: COMPANION-002 met its ORR endpoint and improved PFS but not overall survival; Compass plans to submit anyway, citing crossover.
items.title: FDA asks for survival trial before tovecimig filing in biliary tract cancer

items.keyData: Phase 1b (n=11 at 12 mg/kg) · ORR 45.5% · CR 27.3%
items.summary: Galectin-9–targeting antibody combined with a hypomethylating agent; a randomized phase 2 trial is planned.
items.title: Fast track for LYT-200 plus HMA in high-risk relapsed MDS

items.keyData: EMBER-3 ESR1m subgroup (n=159) · mPFS 11.1 vs 5.5 mo · HR 0.53 · ORR 35% vs 15%
items.summary: For ER+/HER2− ESR1-mutated disease after at least one line of endocrine therapy, with Guardant360 CDx as companion diagnostic. Imlunestrant alone showed no PFS gain without ESR1 mutation.
items.title: FDA approves imlunestrant plus abemaciclib for ESR1-mutated advanced breast cancer

items.keyData: TRUST-I TKI-naive · mDOR 49.7 mo at 51 mo follow-up
items.summary: Label now reflects 14 more months of TRUST-I and TRUST-II follow-up; safety sections unchanged.
items.title: Taletrectinib label updated with longer response data in ROS1+ NSCLC

items.keyData: Based on phase 1/2 RMC-GI-102 · RASolute 302: 60% ↓ risk of death vs chemo (2L)
items.summary: The oral RAS(ON) multi-selective inhibitor, approved as monotherapy in August for previously treated disease, is now being tested first-line in RASolute 303.
items.title: Breakthrough designation for daraxonrasib + gem/nab-paclitaxel in first-line metastatic PDAC

items.keyData: APEX · ORR 65% (mIWG-MRT-ECNM, n=68)
items.summary: NDA accepted for the selective KIT D816V inhibitor; separate applications in non-advanced SM and GIST are also under review.
items.title: Bezuclastinib in advanced systemic mastocytosis

items.summary: Pairs sponsors with research institutions and allows rolling review of IND components. Applications due 30 October 2026; 8–10 pairs to be selected by 18 December.
items.title: FDA launches Expedited IND pilot for first-in-human trials

items.keyData: ERASMUS (n=360) · ORR 17% · mDOR 35 mo
items.summary: A second lutetium-177 dotatate product joins Lutathera, approved on the single-arm ERASMUS study.
items.title: FDA approves Bexlutry (Lu-177 dotatate) for SSTR+ GEP-NETs

items.keyData: ALA-BCC-CT013 (n=187) · complete response ~66% vs 5% vehicle at 12 wk
items.summary: First photodynamic therapy drug approved for a skin cancer.
items.title: Aminolevulinic acid gel with photodynamic therapy approved for superficial BCC

items.keyData: Supported by data from 382 patients
items.summary: Helps distinguish recurrent or progressive glioma from treatment-related change, including post-radiation effects, in adults and children. A negative scan does not exclude recurrence.
items.title: FDA approves 18F-FET (Pixclara), first amino acid PET agent for glioma

items.keyData: ES-SCLC · monitoring 22–24 h → 6–8 h
items.summary: Monitoring after cycle 1 doses drops from 22–24 hours to 6–8 hours plus a next-day review. Patients stay within 1 hour of care for 48 hours with a caregiver; boxed warnings unchanged.
items.title: Tarlatamab label cuts post-infusion monitoring for first two doses

items.keyData: STELLAR-303 · mOS 10.9 vs 9.4 mo vs regorafenib · HR 0.80
items.summary: FDA extended the review by 3 months to examine updated data. Grade ≥3 treatment-related AEs 60% vs 37%.
items.title: Zanzalintinib + atezolizumab in metastatic colorectal cancer

items.keyData: 60 mg tablet ≡ 34.5 mg capsule
items.summary: Not interchangeable mg-for-mg with the tablet: a 60 mg tablet dose equals a 34.5 mg capsule dose, and the label carries a boxed warning on medication errors. Can be taken with or without food.
items.title: Cabozantinib capsule formulation (Omcazio) gets final approval

items.keyData: SOHO-01 1L (n=69) · confirmed ORR 75% · 38% DOR ≥12 mo
items.summary: Accelerated approval now covers nonsquamous NSCLC with HER2 TKD activating mutations regardless of prior therapy.
items.title: Sevabertinib approval expanded to treatment-naive HER2-mutant NSCLC

items.keyData: SERENA-6 · mPFS 16.8 vs 9.2 mo · HR 0.45 (ASCO 2026 update)
items.summary: For HR+/HER2− advanced breast cancer when ESR1 mutation appears on ctDNA during AI + CDK4/6 therapy, with Guardant360 CDx. Approved despite a negative ODAC vote in April; confirmatory trial required.
items.title: Camizestrant switch on emerging ESR1 mutation gets accelerated approval

items.keyData: RASolute 302 · death risk ↓60% vs chemotherapy
items.summary: The oral RAS(ON) multi-selective inhibitor is the first RAS-directed therapy to improve survival in pancreatic adenocarcinoma, based on the phase 3 RASolute 302 trial.
items.title: FDA approves daraxonrasib for previously treated metastatic pancreatic cancer

items.keyData: HERIZON-GEA-01 · triplet mOS 26.4 vs 19.2 mo (HR 0.72) · mPFS 12.4 vs 8.1 mo (HR 0.63)
items.summary: The HER2 bispecific zanidatamab plus tislelizumab and fluoropyrimidine-platinum chemo (HER2 IHC 3+ or 2+/ISH+), or zanidatamab plus chemo alone (IHC 3+), beat trastuzumab-chemo first line.
items.title: FDA approves zanidatamab ± tislelizumab with chemo for first-line HER2+ gastroesophageal adenocarcinoma

items.summary: For relapsed myeloma after at least one prior line including a proteasome inhibitor and an IMiD.
items.title: Iberdomide + daratumumab SC + dexamethasone gets accelerated approval in myeloma

items.summary: Accelerated approval for unresectable advanced cutaneous melanoma progressing on PD-1–based therapy, after two earlier rejections.
items.title: Oncolytic virus vusolimogene oderparepvec + nivolumab approved for PD-1–refractory melanoma
